nipuṇabodhāya bodhadārḍhyahetunirvikṣepatāsiddhaye kiṃcidvarṇyamānaṃ
rahasyamupaśamaprakaraṇādau kathitameva punaḥ kimarthamucyate
ityanāsthāvāraṇāyāha - punaḥpunariti

utpattisthitiprakaraṇābhyāmutpannaṃ jagaditthaṃ bhrāntimātramiti vijñāte sati
samadarśanapratiṣṭhayā upaśamaprakaraṇe samadarśanaṃ varṇitaṃ tadevātra
jīvannirvāṇasukhapratiṣṭhārthaṃ punarvarṇyata ityāha - rāghavetyādinā

saṃsāradṛṣṭiṣu vyavahāreṣu yathā yena prakāreṇa vihartavyaṃ tatkiṃcidrahasyaṃ naḥ
asmanmukhātte śrotavyamasti taducyata ityarthaḥ
bālye tvadvayasyeva jagatsthitiṃ buddhvā vakṣyamāṇarītyā nirvikṣepaṃ vastavyam

saṃpado bāhyāḥ saubhāgyāni subhagabhāvāḥ
kalyāṇaguṇā iti bhedaḥ
tadeva dvividhaṃ phalaṃ prakaṭayati - samateti dvābhyām

samatayā subhagā
sarvabhūtahitā īhā ceṣṭā yeṣām

svadoṣaḥ krodhalobhādiḥ krameṇa śāntyaudāryādibhāvena pariṇamya guṇavadācarati
guṇāyate

samuditaḥ kalyāṇaguṇaiḥ sarvasaṃpadbhiśca samyagabhyudayaṃ prāptaḥ samudāyatāṃ
prāptaśca
sarvakārye svakārye parakārye ca samaṃ puruṣam

yadyathā kartumucitaṃ tattathā yena kriyate ānandodvegau harṣāmarṣau tanmuktena sarvaṃ
kṛtaṃ samatayā yena dṛśyate

aninditānapi sarvānupādeyān parairupādātumiṣṭān
gṛhakṣetrādibhāvāṃstyaktvā uttamāṃ nirlobhasaṃtoṣalakṣaṇāṃ vṛttiṃ dadhānāṃ

samāśayo janaḥ parahitārthaṃ prakṛtakramasaṃprāptaṃ mukhendau kopaṃ dhārayati
cettadapyamṛtavadeva syānnodvegakaraṃ kasyacidityarthaḥ
yatkarma anucitamiti nindati janastatpariharaṃstadasya saccaritraṃ sarvaṃ stauti
aśubhaṃ pramādakṛtamaparādhamapi cireṇa kṛtamadya kṛtaṃ vā tadapyabhinandati
sukhaduḥkheṣu bhīmeṣu ghoreṣu saṃtateṣu cirānuvṛtteṣu vairasyaṃ cittodvegam

kapotāya
śaraṇāgatakapotaprāṇarakṣaṇāya tanmāṃsapratinidhitayā aṅgavikartanaṃ svamāṃsaṃ
dadau
svasya paṇe vāgdyūte hāritaṃ rākṣasena jitam
parivikrītaṃ aicchikīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ te dāsyāmīti pratijñayā brāhmaṇāya vikrītaprāyam

pāṇḍumacalaṃ kailāsamiva sthitamairāvatamindrajayena labdhaṃ punaryajñe ṛtvijāṃ
vacanādindrāya jahau dadau

nijaṃ dehayātrānimittaṃ kramaṃ vyavahāraṃ samayaiva dhiyā āharan ācaran kuṇḍapo
nāma mātaṅga ekāṃ gāṃ vetanīkṛtya brāhmaṇasya pañca paṅkamagnā gāḥ
samuddhṛtya svavetanīkṛtāṃ gāṃ puṣkare samayā dhiyā tasmai brāhmaṇāya dattvā
sadyaḥ samāgataṃ vimānamāruhya vaimānikasthitiṃ devatvaṃ prāpa

kapardananāmā rājarṣiḥ puruṣaḥ puṃstvātsurastrībhogasamartho'pi praṇayinīṣu
svasminsānurāgāsvapi na lulubhe

sa eva rājyaṃ tyaktvā vindhyakāntārakaccheṣu karañjagahaneṣvapi aspandaḥ
saṃściramavasat
vrateṣu tapaḥkleśeṣu ṛddhiṣu bhogeṣu ca samadṛṣṭitayā nodvignāḥ
samatayā kalitā guṇā aguṇā doṣāśca ekabhāvā ekībhūtā iva yasya

paropatāpacintaḥ iti
pāṭhe paraiḥ kṛtā upatāpāstatprayuktacintāśca samatayā kalitā yena

tathā same
sukhaduḥkhe parā utkṛṣṭayonayo'varā nikṛṣṭayonayaśca yasya

tathā samāḥ
avamānā mānāśca yasya tathāvidho jīvanmuktaḥ
prakṛtavyavahāreṣvapyāsaktyabhāvātpūtamūrtirata eva vilāsī vilasanaśīlaḥ san
lokānugrahāya deśāan pravicarati saṃcaratītyarthaḥ
